prescriptions.title: Begelman, Rossi & Armitage (2008)
prescriptions.assumptions: Radiation dominated convective envelope; low BH/envelope mass; unresolved central accretion flow
prescriptions.validity: Hot optically thick envelope; do not apply the analytic photosphere scalings as an EOS
prescriptions.variables_units: L erg/s, M g, rho g/cm^3, P dyn/cm^2; alpha dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Eq 3 is a selectable luminosity law. Fixed excision geometry is an additional QStarS approximation, not BRA equilibrium replication.

prescriptions.title: Ball et al. (2011)
prescriptions.assumptions: BH-only Bondi radius; rho~r^-3/2 cavity; loaded polytrope
prescriptions.validity: Reference n=2,3,4 polytropes; complete stellar tracks require different microphysics
prescriptions.variables_units: xi and phi dimensionless; accretion g/s; radius cm
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Eq 15 prints 4pi despite Eq 12 plus rB=2GM/cs^2 implying 16pi. Preserve printed mode; do not blend with QUEST. Table 1 stored as unreplicated target.

prescriptions.title: Dotan, Rossi & Shaviv (2011)
prescriptions.assumptions: Porous radiation-driven sonic boundary; empirical wind function W; photon-tiring cap
prescriptions.validity: Only effective launch prescription, not a solved porous atmosphere/wind
prescriptions.variables_units: mdot g/s, L erg/s, gas sound speed cm/s, W dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Use gas isothermal sound speed; gamma<=1 gives zero. Wind enthalpy and energy to escape are separately charged.

prescriptions.title: Ball (2012) thesis
prescriptions.assumptions: Boundary choice changes the evolutionary sequence and its mass limit
prescriptions.validity: No single universal quasi-star BH mass limit
prescriptions.variables_units: M g, r cm, thermodynamic quantities CGS
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Inspected boundary discussion and contents; thesis has 145 pages and was not audited line by line. Alternatives must remain explicit.

prescriptions.title: Fiacconi & Rossi (2016)
prescriptions.reference_location: Section 2.1; Eqs 1-3; wind coupling in Section 3
prescriptions.assumptions: Stationary spherical radiation-dominated wind; radiation enthalpy advection
prescriptions.validity: Gas pressure negligible and wind base optically thick
prescriptions.variables_units: mdot g/s, L erg/s, specific Bernoulli energy erg/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Radiation enthalpy matters. A photon-tiring cap alone cannot reproduce these solutions; full transonic replication remains pending.

prescriptions.title: Coughlin & Begelman (2024)
prescriptions.assumptions: Radiation-dominated saturated inner convection matched to n=3 outer envelope
prescriptions.validity: Dimensionless static structure; thin radiative layer approximation
prescriptions.variables_units: xi, m, Ki dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Direct ODE integration distinguishes corrected Bondi and saturated families. Printed Ki=.46554 and mBH/Mi=.6321 correspond to x_tilde=1, not the stated entropy minimum near 1.015. Retain both and document discrepancy.

prescriptions.title: Campbell, Santarelli & Caplan (2025)
prescriptions.assumptions: MESA EOS/opacity, ML1 convection, cavity, TOV correction
prescriptions.validity: Full published run depends on MESA r24.03.1
prescriptions.variables_units: CGS; epsilon, eta dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Early note Eq 3 lacks (1-epsilon) while using a BH growth convention. Later article and source code have it. No silent normalization correction.

prescriptions.title: Santarelli et al. (2025/2026)
prescriptions.assumptions: Convection-limited accretion with explicit radiative efficiency; MESA full tracks
prescriptions.validity: Luminosity law does not reproduce its moving cavity or saturated-convection boundary
prescriptions.variables_units: mdot_BH=(1-epsilon)mdot_rest g/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Named quest2025_eq11 uses 16pi and distinct rest/BH rates; upstream HEAD inspected at 671eb9b898b28c0d02a6a2455dacc0f5b269e280.

prescriptions.title: Hassan et al. (2025/2026)
prescriptions.assumptions: Self-consistent Bondi radius including rho~r^-3/2 cavity
prescriptions.validity: Below critical mass, choose small positive radius continuous as MBH tends to zero
prescriptions.variables_units: rho g/cm^3, cs cm/s, N dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Solve Appendix A cubic directly for stability near zero BH mass; verified equivalent to printed Eq 6. An initial factor-of-two audit suspicion was retracted (Report 4). Full ~0.33 evolutionary limit remains unreplicated.

prescriptions.title: Cantiello et al. (2025/2026)
prescriptions.assumptions: GYRE 8.1 nonadiabatic radial modes with fixed inner displacement and MESA microphysics
prescriptions.validity: Linear stability results cannot be inferred from nonlinear solver failures
prescriptions.variables_units: Eigenfrequency complex; periods time; growth rates inverse time
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: QStarS Mach or solver stops are domain/numerical exits, not a pulsational-instability diagnosis.

prescriptions.title: Roman-Garza et al. (2026)
prescriptions.assumptions: Cold net mass gain; MESA 25.10.1; nuclear evolution and GR progenitor; late extrapolation
prescriptions.validity: Net-gain sequences do not establish separate feeding/wind thermodynamics
prescriptions.variables_units: Mass solar masses, time yr, luminosity solar luminosities in tables
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Do not equate prescribed net gain with a resolved simultaneous two-stream flow; do not mistake analytically extrapolated late evolution for a completed stellar run.

prescriptions.title: Begelman & Dexter (2026)
prescriptions.reference_location: Late-stage quasi-star structural and spectral discussion
prescriptions.assumptions: Saturated envelope assumptions and late BH-dominated evolution
prescriptions.validity: Qualitative context; not a QStarS spectral prediction
prescriptions.variables_units: CGS, solar mass where stated
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Spectral interpretation requires atmosphere microphysics absent from this solver.

prescriptions.title: Martins, Schaerer & Marques-Chaves (2026)
prescriptions.assumptions: Expanding spherical non-LTE CMFGEN atmospheres
prescriptions.validity: 5000-12000 K atmosphere models; not interior LTE closure
prescriptions.variables_units: T K, L solar luminosities
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Grey flux temperature is not a synthetic spectrum or a validated wind photosphere.

prescriptions.title: MESA technical documentation, energy equation
prescriptions.reference_location: dedt and eps_grav descriptions; MESA V section 3 Eq 8 cited there
prescriptions.assumptions: Total-energy conservation and thermodynamic consistency are distinct from resolution convergence
prescriptions.validity: Stellar evolution numerical practice
prescriptions.variables_units: e erg/g, P dyn/cm^2, V_rho cm^3/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Use independent energy residuals plus mesh/time convergence. The implementation derives its own spherical discrete work identity, not a transcription of MESA.

prescriptions.title: MESA installation and upstream QUEST
prescriptions.assumptions: Validated microphysics requires versioned EOS/opacity/atmosphere infrastructure
prescriptions.validity: Existing MESA 24.08.1 and ARM SDK 24.7.1 recovered from earlier runtime; local build changes recorded
prescriptions.variables_units: Not applicable
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Direct EOS and opacity calls are implemented for fixed H/He composition. Stellar evolution, atmosphere, and moving cavity production gates remain open. Report 5 corrects the earlier absence claim.

prescriptions.title: Classical ideal-gas plus radiation thermodynamics
prescriptions.reference_location: Dotan Eqs 21-23; first-law derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Nondegenerate fully ionized monatomic mixture in LTE; fixed composition
prescriptions.validity: 1e5 <= T <= 1e8 K, electron occupation < 0.1, Newtonian low compactness
prescriptions.variables_units: P dyn/cm^2, u erg/g, s erg/g/K
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Heat capacities, adiabatic exponents, and entropy derived consistently from the same EOS; arbitrary entropy zero explicitly fixed.

prescriptions.title: Electron-scattering opacity
prescriptions.reference_location: Section 2.3; Thomson cross section times electrons per gram
prescriptions.assumptions: Fully ionized H/He mixture; scattering dominates; LTE/thermalization separately assumed
prescriptions.validity: Hot diffuse envelope; no bound-free/free-free/negative hydrogen/line opacity
prescriptions.variables_units: kappa=0.2(1+X) cm^2/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: No cool extrapolation admitted as validated physics. Optional external opacity tables strictly reject out-of-bounds values and require provenance.

prescriptions.title: Rosseland radiative diffusion
prescriptions.reference_location: Temperature-gradient controls; diffusion derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Optically thick LTE; F=-ac/(3 kappa rho) grad(T^4)
prescriptions.validity: Radiation gradient Knudsen number <=0.1; LTE assumed; no resolved optically thin transfer
prescriptions.variables_units: Flux erg/cm^2/s; luminosity erg/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Backward-Euler diffusion shares exactly one flux per face; grey extrapolation is an optional outer closure.

prescriptions.title: Optically thick lossless mixing-length limit
prescriptions.reference_location: ML1 reference in Section II; explicit derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Local buoyant blobs, no radiative heat leakage; l=alpha Hp
prescriptions.validity: Pe>=100 where convection carries more than 1 percent of transported flux; subsonic blobs; not full ML1 or time-dependent convection
prescriptions.variables_units: cp erg/g/K; velocity cm/s; l cm
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Use v^2=g delta l^2 (nabla-nabla_ad)/(8Hp), F=rho cp T v l (nabla-nabla_ad)/(2Hp), capped by P cs. Entropy contrast discretized consistently.

prescriptions.title: Compatible spherical mechanical work
prescriptions.reference_location: Compatible differencing principle; QStarS derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Fixed shell masses during mechanical substep; midpoint pressure and velocity; spherical gravity quadrature
prescriptions.validity: Smooth subsonic flow; no shock validation
prescriptions.variables_units: Total energy erg; nodal velocity cm/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Secant area and 1/(r_new r_old) gravity produce exact work cancellation; no energy residual compensation. Article discovered as methodological background; full PDF not audited.

prescriptions.title: Conservative boundary source-cell closure
prescriptions.reference_location: First-law open-system derivation; compare wind Eq 3
prescriptions.assumptions: Separate mass sources/sinks at first/last cell; comoving mixing; supplied enthalpy and entropy specified
prescriptions.validity: Effective 1D boundary mixing; unresolved geometry, shocks, inflow momentum
prescriptions.variables_units: Mass g, enthalpy erg/g, entropy erg/g/K
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Differentiate discrete gravitational energy for boundary potential flux; central-potential work is separately recorded. Wind escape cost debits outward light once.

prescriptions.title: Conservative overlap remapping
prescriptions.assumptions: Piecewise constant volume and total specific energy in mass coordinates
prescriptions.validity: Smooth resolved states; remap changes entropy and hydrostatic residual
prescriptions.variables_units: Mass g, volume cm^3, energy erg
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: New internal energy is remapped total energy minus new discrete gravity and kinetic energies. Reject negative internal energy; log entropy changes.

prescriptions.title: MESA 24.08.1 EOS and opacity public APIs
prescriptions.reference_location: eosDT_get, kap_get; eos_def quantity definitions; source commit 5c166bf174b477823a2ca0031c4f57210c8e67a8
prescriptions.assumptions: Fixed H1/He4 composition Z=0; default EOS blends and Type2 opacity with Zbase=0; matched electron state
prescriptions.validity: Query rectangle rho=1e-14..1e3 g/cm3 and T=3000..1e8 K is only a bounding box. Reject neutral ideal backstop and first-law defect above 1 percent; no production atmosphere claim.
prescriptions.variables_units: P erg/cm3, u erg/g, s erg/g/K, kappa cm2/g; derivatives with respect to natural logarithms
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Versioned C ABI and Python interface cross-checked against separate Fortran process. Wide audit preserves failing blend states. Existing binary/build/table provenance must accompany each run.

prescriptions.title: Inverse radiative/convective flux solve
prescriptions.reference_location: Algebraic derivation in docs/equations.md, using existing diffusion and lossless MLT equations
prescriptions.assumptions: Same physical closure as forward flux; luminosities retained as nonlinear unknowns; active-piece complex-step derivatives
prescriptions.validity: Smooth subsonic hot envelopes; transport validity unchanged by nonlinear method
prescriptions.variables_units: L erg/s, logarithmic thermal contrast dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Solving thermal contrast from luminosity avoids ill conditioning near adiabatic stratification; no transport coefficient changed. Numerical reference is QStarS derivation, not copied MESA implementation.

prescriptions.title: Levermore & Pomraning (1981)
prescriptions.assumptions: Near LTE and slowly varying radiation energy over a mean free path; no flux-limiter implementation added
prescriptions.validity: R=|grad E|/(kappa rho E)<=0.1, using E=aT^4. Cell optical depth remains a diagnostic, not a mesh-dependent validity restriction.
prescriptions.variables_units: R dimensionless, photon mean free path cm
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Corrects prior tau_cell>=1 rejection, which incorrectly rejected increasingly fine representations of a smooth diffusive field. R<=0.1 is a conservative screening threshold, not a proof of full atmosphere validity.
